title: Basic IOS Error Messages
description: Recognize and interpret common IOS error messages.
scenario: Recognize and interpret common IOS error messages.

concepts.title: % Invalid Input
concepts.body: Appears when you type a command IOS does not recognize. Check spelling and mode.
concepts.code:
SW1# shwow version
         ^
% Invalid input detected at '^' marker

concepts.title: % Incomplete Command
concepts.body: Appears when a command is missing required parameters. IOS does not know what to do.

concepts.title: % Ambiguous Command
concepts.body: Appears when an abbreviation matches multiple commands. Type more characters or use ?.
concepts.code:
SW1# sh ip
% Ambiguous command
SW1# show ip ?

concepts.title: % Bad IP Address
concepts.body: Appears when you enter an invalid IP address or mask.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# ip address 999.999.999.999 255.255.255.0
% Bad IP address
